Upstream https://github.com/yetone/magpie-releases/releases/tag/v0.1.4752

Downstream build `bf11222ee260a4867f4865cf75c627a0bc760116`. Windows desktop executable and macOS DMG / update ZIP.

## Features
- Introduced the name “Magpie Artifacts” for artifacts.

## Bug Fixes
- Fixed copied asks losing their text.

## Improvements
- The number of agents that have read an artifact now displays as a count.

### Install

Download from [usemagpie.ai](https://usemagpie.ai), or `curl -fsSL https://usemagpie.ai/install.sh | sh`. An installed magpie updates itself.

- **macOS (Apple Silicon):** `magpie-darwin-arm64.dmg`
- **macOS (Intel):** `magpie-darwin-amd64.dmg`
- **Windows:** `magpie-windows-amd64.exe` (ARM: `magpie-windows-arm64.exe`)
- **Linux:** `magpie-linux-amd64` / `magpie-linux-arm64` (needs GTK 3 and WebKitGTK 4.1)
- **Terminal only:** `magpie-cli-<os>-<arch>`
